The leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult in one of the world’s worst cult disasters in recent history.
The sentence, comprising 100 years for murder by starvation and 100 years by direct homicide, came two weeks after the court in Kenya’s coastal city of Mombasa found the cult leader guilty of the crimes.

Rainfall exceeded forecasts, with an estimated 80mm falling in the city, compared with expectations of 30mm. Two people were killed in the floods.

topArticle.description: After ending the first round 2.2 million votes behind his opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula won the election with a difference of 4 million votes, and will serve a fourth term as president
topArticle.titleJa: いかにして街頭とソーシャルメディア軍がルーラをブラジルでの歴史的勝利に導いたか
topArticle.summary: ルーラは、最初の投票で相手に220万票差をつけられた後、400万票差で当選し、4期目の大統領を務めることになる。

topArticle.title: Australia considers criminal penalties for rogue AI in wake of OpenAI hack
topArticle.description: AI safety regulator will also be created after a rogue OpenAI agent hacked government websites.
topArticle.titleJa: オーストラリア、OpenAIハッキング事件を受け、不正AIに対する刑事罰を検討
topArticle.summary: オーストラリアが不正なAIによる政府ウェブサイトへのハッキング事件を受け、AI安全規制機関の設立と刑事罰の導入を検討している。

topArticle.title: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
topArticle.description: The national mood is low, and faith in politics even lower - with voters deserting the major parties at the polls.
topArticle.titleJa: 「うんざり」「疲弊」「シニカル」：異例の暗い国民がニュージーランド史上最も接戦の選挙をもたらす
topArticle.summary: ニュージーランドの国民感情が低く、政治への信頼も低下。有権者が主要政党から離反し、近年稀に見る接戦の選挙結果となった。

topArticle.title: One killed in Indonesia helicopter crash during firefighting operation
topArticle.description: An Indonesian crew member was killed, while an Australian and New Zealander were rescued after the crash.
topArticle.titleJa: インドネシアで消火活動中のヘリコプター墜落、1人死亡
topArticle.summary: インドネシアでの消火活動中にヘリコプターが墜落し、インドネシア人乗組員1名が死亡、オーストラリア人とニュージーランド人各1名が救助された。

topArticle.title: Homes and temples glow across India to mark Diwali
topArticle.description: Millions of Indians are marking the festival of lights with glowing lamps, fireworks and traditional sweets.
topArticle.titleJa: インド全土でディワリを祝い、家々や寺院が光り輝く
topArticle.summary: 数百万人のインド人がディワリ（光の祭り）を祝い、輝くランプ、花火、伝統的なお菓子で祝祭ムードに包まれている。

topArticle.title: EU launches safeguard investigation on certain PET resin chemicals
topArticle.description: On 6 November 2026, the European Union notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day (6 November 2026), a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate resin chemicals.
topArticle.titleJa: EU、特定PET樹脂化学品に対しセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: 2026年11月6日、EUは特定のPET樹脂化学品の輸入に対し、セーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通報しました。

topArticle.title: Trade Policy Review: Viet Nam
topArticle.description: The third review of the trade policies and practices of Viet Nam takes place on 4 and 6 November 2026. The basis for the review is a report by the WTO Secretariat and a report by the Government of Viet Nam.
topArticle.titleJa: 貿易政策審査：ベトナム
topArticle.summary: ベトナムの貿易政策と慣行に関する第3回審査が、WTO事務局とベトナム政府の報告書に基づいて11月4日と6日に実施されます。

topArticle.title: Working Party chair visits Uzbekistan as WTO accession negotiations enter critical phase
topArticle.description: A WTO delegation led by Ambassador Sung-yo Choi of the Republic of Korea, chair of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan, visited Tashkent, Uzbekistan, from 1 to 3 November to support Uzbekistan's preparations for WTO accession as its negotiations enter a critical phase. The visit included high-level consultations with government officials on outstanding issues across the accession process and exchanges with international development partners and the academic community.
topArticle.titleJa: 作業部会座長がウズベキスタンを訪問、WTO加盟交渉が正念場に
topArticle.summary: WTO代表団がウズベキスタンを訪問し、WTO加盟交渉の正念場においてウズベキスタンの準備を支援しました。
